 Harris County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0022
 Michael Wells, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
3-12-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant answers Plaintiff's Original Petition by generally denying each and every allegation contained in it, and
demands strict proof theroef by a preponderance of the evidence, as permitted under Rule 92 of the Texas Rules of
Civil Procedure.
As and for its affirmative defenses, Defendant states the following. First, Plaintiff's own negligence proximately
caused or contributed to the collision, including failure to keep a proper lookout, failure to yield the right-of-way to
oncoming traffic, and failure to control speed under the circumstances. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Parctice
and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility, and Plaintiff may
recover nothing if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, the collision was caused in whole or in part by the acts or omissions of persons or entities other than
Defendant, including an unidentified third-party vehicle, and Defendant requests that the trier of fact assign each
resposnible person a percentage of responsibility.
Third, Plaintiff's alleged damages were not proximately caused by the collision, and to the extent any injury
pre-existed the collision or resulted from a subsequent, unrelated event, Defendant is not liable for it. Defendant
further asserts its right to a credit or offset for any settlement amounts paid by any other party.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
